title: Transfer my car to CarmaCars
summary: Each step of your car's onboarding: sign, upload, the ServiceOntario transfer, the new permit.

steps.text: Your car's steps: what is done, and the one thing to do now.
This step is yours when it says Your turn. Read what to bring, where to go and how long it takes.
Press the button: it opens the page for this step (sign, upload, or the incorporation link).
Ownership transfer: find a ServiceOntario centre, book a time, then press I booked it and enter the time and the centre.
After the counter: tick that the fees are paid and press Transfer done.
Upload the new ownership permit (and any document still asked for) on the car's page.
